name: WALL-OSS flow
notes: WALL-OSS flow checkpoint used by the LeRobot wall_x docs. Each layer's FFN is a two-expert MoE with shared attention: expert 0 keeps Qwen's width (11008) and is the VL expert copied onto Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct's mlp; expert 1 (width 2048) is the action expert and is excluded. x-square-robot/wall-oss-0.5 uses the same init and can be substituted with --checkpoint.
convention: lmms-eval textvqa_val without OCR tokens: '{question}\nAnswer the question using a single word or phrase.', greedy; VQA accuracy with the EvalAI answer processor
